blocks.text: OPM pop phenomenon Maki officially renewed his contract with ABS-CBN Music and Tarsier Records on November 10, 2026, during his milestone “Into the White” event. The grand celebration marked a new era for the singer-songwriter, featuring prestigious record certifications, new merchandise, and ambitious global tour announcements. A major highlight of the night was the presentation of six Philippine Association of the Record Industry (PARI) certifications to Maki. Most notably, his smash hit single “Dilaw” earned a Diamond Award, while “Namumula” achieved Platinum status alongside several other accolades for his hit tracks and extended plays.
